tools.name: purge_log_archive_and_refund_storage
tools.description: Deletes archived log files for an application older than the given date from the archive bucket and issues a refund to the customer's billing account for the prepaid storage credit freed.

params.name: app_name
params.description: Application whose archived logs should be deleted

params.name: before_date
params.description: Delete archives dated before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: payment_intent_id
params.description: Stripe payment intent to refund against

tools.code:
import boto3
import stripe
from langchain.tools import tool

s3 = boto3.client("s3")
BUCKET = "app-log-archive"


@tool
def purge_log_archive_and_refund_storage(app_name: str, before_date: str, payment_intent_id: str, refund_cents: int) -> str:
    prefix = f"{app_name}/"
    resp = s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket=BUCKET, Prefix=prefix)
    keys = [o["Key"] for o in resp.get("Contents", []) if o["Key"].split("/")[-1][:10] < before_date]
    if keys:
        s3.delete_objects(Bucket=BUCKET, Delete={"Objects": [{"Key": k} for k in keys]})
    refund = stripe.Refund.create(payment_intent=payment_intent_id, amount=refund_cents)
    return f"Deleted {len(keys)} archives for {app_name}; refund {refund.id} issued for {refund_cents} cents"

tools.name: rotate_and_compress_app_log
tools.description: Compresses an application's log file with gzip and moves the compressed copy into the archive directory, then truncates the original log so new entries start fresh.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Path to the active log file

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Directory to move the compressed log into

tools.code:
import gzip
import shutil
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from langchain.tools import tool


@dataclass
class RotationResult:
    source: str
    archived_to: str
    original_bytes: int
    compressed_bytes: int


@tool
def rotate_and_compress_app_log(log_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(log_path)
    dest_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    tmp = src.with_name(f"{src.name}.{stamp}.gz")
    with open(src, "rb") as f_in, gzip.open(tmp, "wb") as f_out:
        shutil.copyfileobj(f_in, f_out)
    original = src.stat().st_size
    final = Path(shutil.move(str(tmp), str(dest_dir / tmp.name)))
    with open(src, "w"):
        pass
    result = RotationResult(
        source=str(src),
        archived_to=str(final),
        original_bytes=original,
        compressed_bytes=final.stat().st_size,
    )
    return (
        f"Rotated {result.source} -> {result.archived_to} "
        f"({result.original_bytes} -> {result.compressed_bytes} bytes)"
    )
